notes: PAP reference G44/1126. Private-owner three-room apartment in Amiens's Plein Sud district, on the fourth floor. The full advert describes 69 m2 with two bedrooms, bright rooms, a fully equipped kitchen area and a cellar. It highlights the calm residential setting, nearby bus stops, schools and services. The detail page exposed eight property photos; the retained source image is the first advertised photo. No DPE letter, condominium charge or property-tax amount was exposed in the accessible text.

PAP reference G52/2711. Private-owner T3 in Amiens Saint-Pierre, at the top of a small secure two-storey building. The full advert describes about 80 m2, a roughly 40 m2 bright through-living room, equipped kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom, separate WC, storage and a basement parking space. It states good general condition, no major work required, individual electric heating, double glazing, DPE C and GES B. The advert gives charges of about EUR 406 per quarter; the directly stated quarterly figure is retained as EUR 1,624 annually despite a conflicting monthly approximation. Taxe fonciere is EUR 1,800 per year. The detail page exposed seven property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo.

PAP reference G17/0211. Private-owner studio in the calm residential Henriville area of south Amiens. The full advert describes a renovated one-room apartment, displayed as 24 m2 in the verified headline and summary, in a building with a lift. The current price is EUR 80,000, reduced from EUR 85,000. The detail page exposed seven property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo. No DPE letter, charge amount or tax amount was exposed in the accessible text.

PAP reference G43/2799. Private-owner T2 on the first floor of a three-storey 2007 residence on rue des Teinturiers in Amiens. The full advert describes 40 m2 with a south-facing 22 m2 living room and equipped kitchen, 10 m2 bedroom, shower room and WC, plus a non-allocated parking place. It states DPE C, a full July 2026 refurbishment and proximity to the Citadelle campus, city centre and SNCF station. The apartment is explicitly free of occupation. The detail page exposed three property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo.

PAP reference G47/1842. Private-owner four-room apartment in Amiens Saint-Leu. The full advert describes 114 m2 with a large through-living area and ethanol fireplace, three bedrooms, a 13 m2 bathroom/shower room that could be divided, a dedicated utility room, private cellar and included parking space. It emphasizes walkable access to shops, school and universities. The detail page exposed eleven property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo. No DPE letter, charge amount or property-tax amount was exposed in the accessible text.

PAP reference G43/1125. Private-owner two-room apartment close to Amiens city centre and shops. The full advert describes 39 m2, individual electric heating, an 8 m2 terrace facing a quiet internal courtyard, several bus routes outside and proximity to the SNCF station. It says the apartment is fully furnished, in excellent condition, in a late-2011 high-standard residence with low condominium charges. The detail page exposed eleven property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo. No exact charge, DPE or tax value is asserted.

PAP reference G28/3029. Private-owner T4 in a high-standard residence in Amiens Henriville, five minutes on foot from the city centre. The full advert describes 117 m2 with a large entrance, double living room, fitted kitchen, three bedrooms including a principal suite with private bathroom and WC, a shower room with laundry area and extensive fitted storage. A basement parking place and cellar are included, and the building has a lift. The detail page exposed nine property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo. No DPE letter, charge amount or property-tax amount was exposed in the accessible text.

PAP reference G22/1258. Private-owner furnished studio on rue des Saintes Claires in central Amiens, on the fourth floor of a five-storey 2000 residence with lift. The full advert describes 18 m2 with a kitchenette-equipped living room, furniture, storage and a bathroom with bath and WC. It says the apartment is quiet and bright, overlooks a garden and the cathedral, lies near the law and science faculties, Citadelle campus and station, and is explicitly free of occupation. The detail page exposed three property photos; the retained URL is its first advertised photo. No DPE, charge or tax amount is asserted.
